html:
Given a positive Gregorian calendar year, return whether it is a leap year.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    2400
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    2100
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

Century years need a divisibility check by 400.

Complexity: O(1) arithmetic operations and space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: leap-year.py
solutions.code:
def solve(year):
    return year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0)
